title: Recording: You Can’t Catch Me by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

John Lennon continued work on ‘You Can’t Catch Me’ for the Rock ‘N’ Roll album on 11 July 1974.

The backing track had been recorded on 11 December 1973, and Lennon added new vocals on 9 July. During this session he added unspecified overdubs to complete the song.

This was the final Rock ‘N’ Roll recording session until 6 October 1974. In the interim Lennon recorded and released the Walls And Bridges album.
